title: Poirot's Rule
author: Agatha Christie
ciphertext: KFKEAYJZVC PHWY TK YDNKV ZVYS DMMSHVY. ZO YJK ODMY BZXX VSY OZY YJK YJKSEA — XKY YJK YJKSEA CS.
plaintext: Everything must be taken into account. If the fact will not fit the theory — let the theory go.
epilogue: Hercule Poirot says it to Captain Hastings, who has just dismissed a curious detail as unimportant. It's from Christie's first novel, which was also Poirot's first case in print.
